observed_current_f2_boundaries.name: Fact/Episode/Method/Process-Policy separation
observed_current_f2_boundaries.material_boundary: Typed Method metadata is mechanically separated from FACT authority; caller-declared type plus exact payload/provenance identity is validated/frozen/fingerprinted without truth or transfer inference.

observed_current_f2_boundaries.name: Recursive Cognitive Process Distillation
observed_current_f2_boundaries.material_boundary: Explicit typed process evidence may form provenance-bound process-pattern candidates with bounded acyclic recursion, but may not infer facts, causal success, method validity, transfer applicability, authority or completion.

observed_current_f2_boundaries.name: Processing credit + method ablations
observed_current_f2_boundaries.material_boundary: Matched baseline/intervention measurements already produce deterministic improvement/regression/tie/insufficient-evidence candidates under pair/generation/schema fences; METHOD_CREDIT_CANDIDATE is explicitly not causal proof or world truth.

observed_current_f2_boundaries.name: ContextCompiler / bounded ContextViews
observed_current_f2_boundaries.material_boundary: Current Stage-3 context substrate includes an accepted ContextCompiler lineage plus epistemic-record-to-context-item adapter, while preserving source/generation and epistemic boundaries.

observed_current_f2_boundaries.name: Whole-system resource/latency/quality characterization
observed_current_f2_boundaries.material_boundary: Later whole-system performance characterization remains the correct destination for F2-specific latency/throughput/goodput/resource claims; donor metric names cannot pre-populate measured results.

donor_to_f2_mapping.donor_pattern: selective method/reference router loading only one or two relevant references
donor_to_f2_mapping.mapping: Represent a routed performance procedure as an existing METHOD-typed, provenance/version-bound reference and let the existing bounded ContextCompiler consume only selected references. Do not add a perf-skills memory database, second context authority or network-dependent catalog.
donor_to_f2_mapping.reason: F2 already has the typed-memory and bounded-context structural authority required to express this pattern; the donor contributes a selection heuristic/method example, not a missing architecture layer.

donor_to_f2_mapping.mapping: Use the donor's paired-evaluation shape only as a task/evidence-generation method feeding the already accepted WP305 matched baseline/intervention comparison primitive. Fix task family, assertions, source/model/config identity and metric schema before execution; preserve regression/tie/insufficient evidence rather than forcing positive credit.
donor_to_f2_mapping.reason: WP305 already owns processing-credit/method-ablation semantics; creating a second evaluator would duplicate authority.

donor_to_f2_mapping.donor_pattern: performance metric taxonomy including TTFT, TPOT/ITL, end-to-end latency, token/request throughput, goodput and tail percentiles with workload-shape controls
donor_to_f2_mapping.mapping: Store the taxonomy as a provenance/version-bound METHOD candidate and later select/calibrate only metrics relevant to declared F2 workloads. No upstream thresholds, capacity numbers or benchmark outcomes are imported.
donor_to_f2_mapping.reason: Metric vocabulary can improve experiment design, but whole-system performance facts belong to WP902 measurements.

donor_to_f2_mapping.donor_pattern: upstream skill corpus / repository filesystem as runtime knowledge authority
donor_to_f2_mapping.mapping: No second truth/memory/context authority. Any reused method must enter through existing provenance-bound F2 method/context contracts or remain external research evidence.

donor_to_f2_mapping.donor_pattern: upstream benchmark or performance uplift claims
donor_to_f2_mapping.mapping: Source-read evidence does not reproduce upstream eval outputs and cannot establish any Frankenstein 2.0 performance improvement.

architecture_conclusion.key_delta_vs_e1: E1 treated WP304/WP305/WP306 chiefly as target architecture areas; granular current F2 evidence shows these primitives are already accepted at repository-hosted component-CI scope. Therefore the donor's architecture value collapses from candidate subsystem to a thin method/evaluation overlay on existing WP303-WP306 boundaries.

serious_counterhypothesis: The donor may be fully redundant even as a thin method overlay because F2-native RCPD, processing-credit ablation and ContextCompiler can already generate/select equivalent methods without imported skill structure.

cheapest_next_discriminator.question: Can one minimal provenance-bound performance METHOD object and one deterministic selection rule be expressed entirely through existing WP303/WP306 shapes and scored through WP305 without schema extensions or a second authority?
acceptance: No new canonical database or truth authority.
No payload-derived fact or transfer inference.
Pinned local reference works with network unavailable.
Method selection can abstain when applicability evidence is insufficient.
Paired evaluation is representable through WP305 matched baseline/intervention identity and metric-schema fences.
Failure means REJECT_AS_REDUNDANT_OR_SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE rather than weakening existing contracts.

nonclaims: No QAInsights/perf-skills benchmark result was reproduced.
No Frankenstein 2.0 performance gain was measured.
No VPS or physical GRID10 execution occurred.
No WP303/WP304/WP305/WP306 runtime acceptance was promoted.
No WP902 measurement or whole-system characterization was performed.
No real effect or completion authority was exercised.
